description: Call this when the user asks whether leverage is entering or leaving the market, about open interest changes, or whether longs or shorts are building in a major coin. Returns 5-minute-resolution OI with 24h OI and price deltas and a four-regime read per symbol: longs building, shorts building, long squeeze, short squeeze, or quiet.
name: get_open_interest
title: Intraday open interest and leverage regimes (10 major perps)
